verdict.rationale: Attio documents a first-party bulk record action surface: when multiple record rows are selected in a list, actions can run across that selection. However, the evidence only shows this as an App SDK extension point that a developer must build, not native bulk editing or AI-driven bulk changes. Missing for 10: documented native bulk edit/update/delete of many records, evidence that the AI/MCP tools can operate on many records at once, bulk REST API endpoints, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
